judgement.reason: Focalboard supports PostgreSQL through configuration, and its file uploads can be moved to S3 or treated as a contained change, so DEPLOYABLE_WITH_CHANGES stands.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /opt/focalboard/data (docker/Dockerfile), volume fbdata:/opt/focalboard/data (docker/docker-compose.yml app)
reviews.reason: The image creates /opt/focalboard/data/files for uploaded files and declares it a volume, and no shown configuration moves those files to S3 or the database to PostgreSQL, so the data directory appears to hold durable state.
